description: This file implements a configuration class for IBM WatsonX audio transcription, translating and adapting requests from an OpenAI-based specification to IBM WatsonX's API. It provides methods to validate environment, handle parameters, transform audio transcription requests into appropriate request data, and construct the API URL.

classes.name: IBMWatsonXAudioTranscriptionConfig
